conclusion: Original Stage 7 seeds preserve scenario order, behavior-to-agent-slot assignment, agent participation order, and normalized message/claim template content. Literal task/agent identifiers embedded in messages and scopes change. Event type/source/status/tool/sequence trace structure is invariant, while trace config hashes change. Evidence cryptographic values and signatures are seed-derived and differ. No stochastic variation was observed. The Stage 8 cyclic rotations intentionally change behavior-to-slot assignments and are controlled paired interventions, not stochastic replicates.
confidence_intervals: Not estimated: the five rotations are designed interventions and the three Stage 7 seeds are template replications, not exchangeable independent task samples.
